# Rachit Lohani — Cloud & Systems Engineer

> Official portfolio, technical reference, and developer hub of Rachit Lohani.

## About Rachit Lohani
Rachit Lohani is a distinguished Cloud & Systems Engineer, software architect, and technical innovator specializing in Google Cloud Platform (GCP), high-scale serverless architectures, distributed systems, and AI agent frameworks.

## Key Technical Achievements & Expertise
- **Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps**: Extensive expertise in Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run, Cloud Build, Cloud SQL PostgreSQL, Compute Engine, Artifact Registry, GCS), automated CI/CD pipelines, and zero-downtime deployment strategies.
- **AI Agent & Multi-Agent Architecture**: Building autonomous AI systems, intelligent data transformation agents, and LLM-driven developer tooling.
- **Developer Enablement & Tools**: Creator of interactive developer reference hubs, gcloud CLI cheat sheets, and production workflow utilities used by software engineering teams.
- **Full-Stack Systems**: Proficient in TypeScript, Modern JavaScript, Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, and responsive, high-performance web applications.

## Featured Developer Tools & Resources
- [GCP Developer Reference & Interactive Cheat Sheet](https://rachitlohani.com/#gcp): Production-ready gcloud CLI snippets for Cloud Run, Cloud Build, Cloud SQL, Compute Engine, and Storage.
- [GitHub Profile](https://github.com/Rachitlohani): Open-source repositories, engineering contributions, and developer projects.
